title: Export
label: Export
checked: SVG output for every gallery example; SVG, PNG, PDF, and Vega output signatures; conversion errors; PNG renderings of 21 plots against baselines.
description: scripts/evidence-tests.php runs the Pest suite with vl-convert and records each export test. Without vl-convert or the GD extension, the cases are recorded as skipped.

comparison.applies_to: SVG output; starts with <svg and contains a mark group
Output signatures; <svg, PNG magic bytes, %PDF-, Vega marks, and ExportFailed on conversion errors
PNG renderings; at most 0.2% of pixels differ by more than 40/255 in the largest channel, and sizes match

cases.name: ExamplesTest
cases.quantity: renders every gallery example to SVG with vl-convert

cases.name: RenderTest
cases.quantity: renders SVG, PNG, PDF, and Vega

exclusions: PNG and PDF output are compared by signature and against the visual baselines, not byte for byte.
The visual plots use Liberation Sans, which vl-convert bundles, and no jitter.
